title: Certify exact pairing cost 21 for the 19-line configuration
body:
## Summary

```diff
-cex_min_1: 20 <= minimum raw pairing cost <= 22
+cex_min_1: minimum raw pairing cost = 21
```

Resolve Q2 of DreamingOfClouds' [independent-check request](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18936173). Add only `research/cex19-exact-pairing/`, with the unchanged configuration, a cost-21 witness, a complete lower-bound certificate and solver-free replay.

The witness has block ranks **7, 6, 8**. Forced triangular pivots reduce the rank sum to `16 + sum(rank(S_j))`. The complete CNF for residual rank sum at most four has 2,856 variables and 9,964 clauses. A shipped **1,301-addition RUP refutation** excludes cost at most 20 across all `2^114` admissible pairings. Two separately implemented propagation algorithms check the entire proof. The README proves encoding completeness; no solver verdict is trusted on replay.

## Evidence

- Before: PR2111's retained multi-copy certificate gave 20; its witness gave 22. PR2162 requested the exact value.
- After: the admissible cost-21 witness and checked cost-at-most-20 refutation give equality. Ten behavioral groups pass normally and with `-O`, including a satisfying assignment at cost 21, rejection after essential budget clauses are removed, independent row/column ranks, full-proof checks and malformed/source/receipt controls.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/cex19-exact-pairing
python3.12 -Werror -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py'
```

The registered replay and all 65 research-workflow tests pass on Linux x86_64 / CPython 3.12.15. Python 3.13.5 optimized smoke verification also passes. No hosted CI result is claimed here.

Contribution head `b0990688174b6f2c6b13410c30974237364eddcd`, based on canonical main `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. Main and selected record were rechecked unchanged. Submission overlap covered 445 open PRs and 896 Discussion records with complete pagination, not code diffs. [Discussion2202](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2202) is the canonical investigation.

Credit remains with DreamingOfClouds for the configuration and predecessor theory. PR2111 is pinned at `98da76c2839ba38538b510420dec54546ccabf0b`; PR2162 at `113a718265c62aec301c5695f4bfb9c421bef7ab`. Both use the same copied Git blob. No predecessor executable is imported. `TASK.json` records the explicit change from the drawn uniform-transfer card to this fresh decoder-audit handoff.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** research.

Only a new scoped package is added. Frozen inputs and the selected frontier are unchanged. This settles one fixed configuration, not the general rank-three decoder problem, physical supplier admission or a new kappa. The encoding argument and proof checkers remain review obligations; no formal-kernel proof or independent human review is claimed.

Open next question: derive a short structural inequality explaining why the exact cost is 21 while the retained multi-copy certificate reaches only 20. The package gives a feasible first step and its current blocker.
